newsitem.title: GERMANY: Krupp steel production halted by protests.
newsitem.headline: Krupp steel production halted by protests.

text.p: Steel production at Fried. Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp was halted by worker protests, a works council spokesman said on Thursday.
The stoppage came ahead of an employee meeting in Dortmund at which management will inform workers about a possible steel merger with Thyssen AG,
The spokesman said plant operations had been run down to emergency levels as workers gathered to march to the meeting, which several thousand of them are expected to attend.

Meanewhile production at Thyssen's Duisburg steelworks was also hit as about 1,000 Thyssen workers downed tools to attend the Krupp meeting in a show of solidarity with Krupp workers, works council officials said.
Workers at Krupp and Thyssen have staged stoppages this week, initially in protest at a hostile takeover bid by Krupp for Thyssen.

The two companies on Wednesday announced they would start talks aimed at forming a joint steel company, possibly averting a takeover, but workers have reacted sceptically and remain concerned that a linkup will entail thousands of job losses.
